windows.licenseBoundary: Operator supplies or accepts responsibility for a valid Windows license. This repository contains no Windows media or license key.

capture.gestureDelivery: inputCore.manager.emulateGesture, matching the official NVDA system-test boundary
capture.claimBoundary: Presentation-request and braille-display-write evidence from real NVDA. Not acoustic output or user-perception evidence.

sshControl.hostKeyPolicy: Pin through the existing host-mounted bootstrap channel; never trust on first network use and fail closed on change.
sshControl.authentication: ed25519 public key only; password and keyboard-interactive authentication disabled
sshControl.payloadUpdate: npm run nvda:windows:sync stages the seven allowlisted runtime files with exact byte counts and SHA-256 hashes. The forced dispatcher independently validates the manifest, file set, and content-derived generation before installation, validates the new sshd configuration, restarts sshd out of band, and waits for key-only control to recover.
sshControl.localeControl: locale-en-US and locale-de-DE atomically select the runtime locale and restart the owned NVDA/Chrome task. NVDA starts with its official --lang override; runtime status attests the active locale and session creation fails closed on mismatch.

cdpBoundary: Chrome listens on guest loopback 9223; the NVDA plugin provides an unprivileged byte-for-byte TCP proxy on guest 9222 for QEMU, whose host mapping binds only 127.0.0.1:9224.
startup: The supervised runtime has both a Task Scheduler AtLogOn trigger and a Common Startup launcher. A global named mutex prevents duplicate supervisors.
